title: Remove or wire up the dead MonthlyActivitySliverCalendar spike before its placeholder class collides with the real Drift companion
rule: dead code / AG-4 (future duplicate top-level name)
why: grep across lib/ and test/ shows MonthlyActivitySliverCalendar is imported nowhere except its own file and its own 171-line test (monthly_activity_sliver_calendar_test.dart) — 404 + 171 = 575 lines maintained since commit 2b2eeb54 (2026-05-20) for zero product value; the widget's own doc comment admits 'not wired into any screen yet'. Worse, its hand-rolled `class MonthlyActivityRollup` is explicitly a stand-in 'until build_runner generates the companion' — but the real monthly_activity_rollups Drift table (already committed, not yet added to UserDatabase's table list) declares @DataClassName('MonthlyActivityRollup'), the identical name. The day someone finishes wiring that table into UserDatabase and runs build_runner, this hand-written class and the generated one collide.
recommendation: Either finish wiring MonthlyActivityRollups into UserDatabase now and switch the widget onto the generated class, or delete the spike widget, its table, and its test until the feature is scheduled.
acceptance_criteria: MonthlyActivitySliverCalendar is either reachable from a real screen route or removed along with its test and orphaned table
No hand-written class reuses a name reserved by a table's @DataClassName annotation
